items.title: Qualify shared administration authorization and mutation behavior
acceptance: Preserve configuration and credential identities
Bind approvals to exact inputs, credentials, endpoint, and target state
Test expiry, rotation, cancellation, competing plans, external writers, duplicate apply, and lost responses without replay

items.title: Complete applicable OmniRoute operation families
acceptance: Refresh route inventory against latest stable exact source
Qualify providers, combos, fallback chains, capability overrides, and mappings first
Qualify all applicable operations including upload, download, stream, WebSocket, and interactive contracts
Record source evidence for non-callable exceptions

items.title: Make provenance and qualification reproducible in clean CI
acceptance: Share content-addressed provenance records
Acquire immutable verified sources without private machine state
Run independent qualification before deterministic regeneration
Changed source, tests, or outcomes invalidate old evidence

items.title: Verify live discovery and both inference protocols
acceptance: Normalize catalog identity and pricing provenance
Verify failure recovery, cancellation, credential rotation, tool continuation, and reasoning
Prevent duplicate SDK installation

items.title: Qualify the same package on all eight OMP targets
acceptance: Run native installation, setup, inference, and administration on Linux x64/arm64 glibc and musl, macOS x64/arm64, and Windows x64/arm64
Bind passing receipts to the same package digest and exact source
Record startup, discovery, lazy administration, memory, and size comparisons

items.title: Complete practical documentation and reproducible media
acceptance: Generate source-owned command, capability, compatibility, and documentation-index tables
Preserve partial staging in deterministic commit hooks
Deliver editable vector and reproducible raster identity with ownership metadata
Record real disposable-data setup/admin screenshots and walkthrough on an isolated display with accessible static alternatives

items.title: Activate reviewed GitHub maintenance and Copilot reviews
acceptance: Verify npm scope access and Copilot entitlement
Configure branch protections and automatic reviews on new pushes
Seed this milestone without duplicates
Run daily checks at 07:17 UTC and trusted default-branch failure reporting
Test duplicate events, overlaps, interrupted requests, and rate limits without exposing security diagnostics

items.title: Publish reviewed 1.0.0 npm and GitHub artifacts
acceptance: Keep VERSION canonical and apply patch-default reviewed release batches
Require a clean signed source commit and signed annotated tag
Require complete operation and eight-target qualification before publication
Bind exact npm/source/media/SBOM/notes/checksums in one approved receipt
Recheck latest upstreams immediately before publication
Verify public hashes, npm install, links, README assets, and actual social preview; reconcile partial failures before retrying
